profile.headline: Driving Technical Strategy & Execution | Software Engineering
profile.summary: Engineering leader passionate about building scalable technology platforms that simplify complex customer experiences.

positions.title: Senior Manager, Staff Software Engineering
positions.locationName: Palo Alto, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Leading a Full stack team building applications that empower contact center agents and supervisors to deliver exceptional customer experiences.

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer/ Engineering Lead
positions.locationName: San Mateo County, California, United States
positions.description:
• Spearheaded the development of the Cloud Builder, Manager & Installer SDK, enhancing provisioning speed and scalability, contributing to significant growth noted in the S-1 filing.  
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to align project deliverables, ensuring timely execution and high-quality outcomes.  
• Mentored and coached engineers across multiple time zones (US, Argentina, Ukraine, India), fostering career growth and facilitating successful hiring processes.

(React, Redux, GraphQL, Apollo, NodeJS, Webpack)
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Methodologies · Software Project Management · Front-End Development · Artificial Intelligence (AI)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented a self-serve web interface for cost-per-lead advertising, enhancing customer sign-up efficiency.  
• Developed scalable full-stack web applications that improved performance and user experience.  
• Created complex SQL queries for Jaspersoft, streamlining internal processes and reporting.

(Java, Spring, Hibernate, DHTML, CSS, AngularJS, GWT, Jaspersoft, iReport, MySql, Hadoop, Hbase)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
- Designed, developed and tested Online reports using Oracle Apex and Oracle BI Publisher.
- Design complex query for data in Oracle 9i.

(Oracle Apex, Html, CSS, JavaScript, MS Excel, Adobe Acrobat)

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
- Work with C under Linux (X2 Framework), Gimp tool for GUI development to study / understand Sony Bravia Internet Video technology, optimize the software library, and apply the results with new Graphic User Interface for the Bravia Sony TV.
Also work with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (jQuery) to design and experiment various GUI designs.

positions.title: Software Trainee
positions.description:
- Develop system to access different type of bank accounts in various formats.

(JavaScript, Html, CSS, J2ee, JSP, Servlets, mySql)
